market_summary: Late New York session trading is characterized by post-trend consolidation across all monitored assets. Following heavy downside expansions earlier in the session, XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, XAGUSD, and BTCUSD are consolidating below their respective session VWAPs, EMA50 baselines, and Value Area Lows while holding slightly above session lows. Trading volume is predominantly subdued (RVOL < 1.0, with GBPUSD printing an absorption spike that failed to generate follow-through), and volatility envelopes are contracting. Capital preservation dictates a clean HOLD across all symbols until fresh session liquidity and clean directional reclaims develop.

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (3884.90) and well below POC (3978.13). CVD is BEARISH (-6.16) with a mild positive slope (+1.66) as price undergoes tight consolidation. Current session is late NEW_YORK_SESSION. The broader intraday trend remains bearish below descending VWAP (3930.36) and EMA50 (3909.64). Price is consolidating mid-channel between the lower ATR band (3865.74) and upper ATR band (3902.69). Volume confirmation is absent with RVOL at 0.85 (grey bar). GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING with price holding above the Gamma Flip (3864.84); price is currently pinned under Call Wall #2 (3885.03) while resting above Session Low (3852.35). Given the dampening regime, lack of volume, and mid-range compression, the setup warrants a HOLD.
